«:archivo» es un PDF o una foto de regis: “:archivo” is a PDF or photo of records that was not read automatically (automatic reading is off or did not finish): the preparer reviews it.
«:archivo» tiene más de :maximo páginas:: “:archivo” has more than :maximo pages: it was not read. The maximum per file is the parameter “lectura.maximo_paginas_renglones”.
Pídele al cliente que lo suba por meses;: Ask the client to upload it month by month; you can leave them a note: “:cliente”
«:archivo» no se mandó a leer con IA: el: “:archivo” was not sent to be read with AI: the client has already used :usadas of :tope pages read with AI this year and this file has :paginas.
Decide: revisa el archivo a mano, pídele: Decide: review the file by hand, ask the client for the Excel template, or raise the limit in Tax catalog of the year → Parameters (“lectura.maximo_paginas_ia_por_cliente”); with the new limit, the file is read when the client uploads it again.
Este archivo tiene demasiadas páginas pa: This file has too many pages to read. Please upload it month by month, one file per month. If you keep your own records, the template is the quickest way.
Ya recibimos muchos extractos y recibos: We have already received many of your statements and receipts this year; your preparer will review this file. If you keep your own records, the template is the quickest way.
Este comando no corre en producción: lla: This command does not run in production: it calls OpenAI for real with the test documents.
Falta la clave de desarrollo de OpenAI (: The OpenAI development key (OPENAI_API_KEY) or the model (OPENAI_VISION_MODEL) is missing.
No hay fixtures que leer en tests/Fixtur: There are no fixtures to read in tests/Fixtures/lectura/montos/.
Sin --tarifa-entrada y --tarifa-salida n: Without --tarifa-entrada and --tarifa-salida the cost is not calculated: pass them in USD per million tokens, with the model's current price.
